notes.title: Progress To Closed Alpha
notes.notes:
[p]Lots of recent progress towards the first Mythfarer closed alpha, hopefully by the end of the year (2025!).[/p][p]Combat is shaping up, but a few features remain to be implemented before the alpha can be released.[/p][p]Here's some of the combat visuals, featuring the ring-of-fire spell:[/p][previewyoutube="QU8Q39b0mVo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Only one major feature, auto-map, remains to be completed before the alpha.[/p][p]Content-wise, The Islands, the area in which your journey will begin, is about 80% complete. The Islands are one area out of 14 (allegedly) in the world of Ankalibar that you'll be able to visit, as shown here in the in-game map:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558624/b90bfa161b471c6ef60aa11afd8cc13799a45e76.png"][/img][/p][p]And with that, we'll get back to work. [/p]
